tools.name: academyofmine_list_courses
tools.description: List the academy's courses with status, categories and author, one page at a time. Start here to find a course id. Academy of Mine API: GET /api/courses/tabularlist.

tools.name: academyofmine_get_course
tools.description: Get one course: metadata, modules, categories, certificate templates and learning resources. Academy of Mine API: GET /api/course/{id}.

tools.name: academyofmine_list_course_learners
tools.description: List the learners enrolled in one course, with progress and registration dates. Personal data: use only for the academy's own reporting. Academy of Mine API: GET /api/course/enrolled-students.

tools.name: academyofmine_list_learning_paths
tools.description: List the academy's learning paths (course bundles), one page at a time. Academy of Mine API: GET /api/learning-paths/tabularlist.

tools.name: academyofmine_get_learning_path
tools.description: Get one learning path with its courses and details. Academy of Mine API: GET /api/learning-path/{id}.

tools.name: academyofmine_list_learning_path_learners
tools.description: List the learners enrolled in one learning path. Personal data: use only for the academy's own reporting. Academy of Mine API: GET /api/enrolled-users.

tools.name: academyofmine_find_users
tools.description: Search users by name or email, with optional portal and user-type filters. Personal data: use only for the academy's own administration. Academy of Mine API: GET /api/users/lookup.

tools.name: academyofmine_get_user
tools.description: Get one user's profile and account details. Personal data: use only for the academy's own administration. Academy of Mine API: GET /api/user/{id}.

tools.name: academyofmine_list_user_certificates
tools.description: List the certificates one user has earned. Academy of Mine API: GET /api/user-certificates/{id}.

tools.name: academyofmine_list_orders
tools.description: List the academy's orders with buyer, product and status, one page at a time. Personal data: use only for the academy's own accounting. Academy of Mine API: GET /api/orders/tabularlist.

tools.name: academyofmine_get_order
tools.description: Get one order with its items, payments and status. Academy of Mine API: GET /api/order/{id}.

tools.name: academyofmine_list_portals
tools.description: List the academy's portals (sites for separate audiences, such as B2B customers), one page at a time. Academy of Mine API: GET /api/portals/tabularlist.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: academyofmine_find_users · Public sink: academyofmine_find_users.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: academyofmine_find_users · Public sink: academyofmine_find_users

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
